name: Melchishua
overview: Melchishua, also known as Malchishua, was one of the sons of King Saul, as recorded in 1 Samuel and 1 Chronicles. He is listed among Saul's sons alongside Jonathan and Abinadab, highlighting his place within the royal family. The Scriptures recount that Melchishua died in battle against the Philistines, emphasizing the tragic loss experienced by Saul's household during this conflict.
